title: argyrochosma microphylla
intro: Argyrochosma microphylla, commonly known as the Western fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Argyrochosma microphylla include antispasmodic and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions like asthma and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
